name: SEO
description: Titles, descriptions and headings written once as a template and applied to the whole catalogue, plus a screen that shows what is still empty and fills it in bulk. The fields themselves belong to the product, the category and the page — they stay when this module is removed; what goes with it is the automation.

settings.label: Length of a description the shop writes itself
settings.help: When a product has no description of its own, the shop cuts one from its text to about this many characters. Search engines show roughly 155–160.
